questions.text: What is a "bucket list"?
opts: A list of life experiences to have
questions.correct: A list of life experiences to have
questions.hint: Kamila's bucket list = experiences she wants to have before she turns thirty.

questions.text: Kamila successfully cycled all 40 kilometres to the village.
questions.hint: She gave up after 15 kilometres when her tyre burst.

questions.text: Kamila jumped from a plane at ___ metres above the steppe.
questions.hint: "She jumped from a plane at 4,000 metres above Kazakhstan's steppe."

questions.text: How many bucket list experiences does Kamila have left?
questions.hint: "She has exactly sixteen experiences left to complete before she turns thirty."

questions.text: Kamila has already been to the Altai Mountains.
questions.hint: "She has never been to the Altai region."

questions.text: How many hiking trips has Rustam been on?
questions.hint: Rustam said: "I've been on five hiking trips."

questions.text: What did the strange sounds near Zhibek's tent turn out to be?
questions.hint: Zhibek said "it turned out to be a deer."

questions.text: Where has Zhibek applied for an exchange programme?
questions.hint: Zhibek mentioned she has applied for a programme in Edinburgh.

questions.text: Zhibek has volunteered at a children's hospital for ___ years.
questions.hint: "I've volunteered at a children's hospital in Uralsk for two years."

questions.text: What is Zhibek's top dream experience?
questions.hint: "I've never seen the Northern Lights. That's my number one dream experience."

questions.text: She ___ five items off her bucket list.
questions.hint: She = third person → has + past participle (crossed).

questions.text: I ___ (never/be) to Edinburgh.
questions.hint: "I" → have + never + past participle. "Be" → participle is "been".

questions.text: She ___ in Almaty in 2021.
questions.hint: "In 2021" = specific time → Past Simple.

questions.text: "yet" goes at the ___ of a negative sentence.
questions.hint: "Yet" always goes at the END: "I haven't finished YET."

questions.text: "I have gone there yesterday" is correct.
questions.hint: "Yesterday" = specific time → Past Simple: "I went there yesterday."

questions.text: Have you ___ tried traditional Kazakh food?
questions.hint: "Ever" goes in questions about life experience: Have you EVER...?

questions.text: She has ___ arrived — she walked in two minutes ago.
questions.hint: "Just" = a very short time ago. Position: has + JUST + past participle.

questions.text: She has studied English ___ 2019.
questions.hint: "2019" = a specific point in time → "since".

questions.text: A "bucket list" item is something you:
opts: Want to experience in your lifetime
questions.correct: Want to experience in your lifetime
questions.hint: A bucket list = a list of experiences or goals you want to achieve before you die.

questions.text: "Terrifying" means very exciting.
questions.hint: "Terrifying" means extremely frightening, not exciting.

questions.text: "volunteer" means to:
opts: Freely offer to help without payment
questions.correct: Freely offer to help without payment
questions.hint: Volunteer = to freely offer to do something, especially for a good cause.

questions.text: What is a "rucksack"?
opts: A bag worn on the back
questions.correct: A bag worn on the back
questions.hint: A rucksack = a bag carried on your back, used for hiking or travel.

questions.text: "Standing ovation" means:
questions.hint: Standing ovation = the audience stands up and applauds enthusiastically.

questions.text: "Look ___ to" means to feel excited about something coming.
questions.hint: "Look forward to" = to feel excited and wait eagerly for something.

questions.text: "perspective" means:
opts: A way of looking at or understanding something
questions.correct: A way of looking at or understanding something
questions.hint: "Perspective" = a particular way of thinking about or understanding something.

questions.text: "deadline" means:
opts: The latest time you must finish something
questions.correct: The latest time you must finish something
questions.hint: "Deadline" = the latest date or time by which something must be completed.

questions.text: "trail" refers to a path in a natural area for hiking.
questions.hint: "Trail" = a path through a natural area, especially for walking or hiking.

questions.text: "so far" means:
opts: Up to this point in time
questions.correct: Up to this point in time
questions.hint: "So far" = until now; up to this moment.

questions.text: "choreograph" a dance means to:
opts: Design and arrange the movements of a dance
questions.correct: Design and arrange the movements of a dance
questions.hint: "Choreograph" = to design and organise the movements in a dance.

questions.text: "___ exchange programme" is a programme where students study at a foreign university.
questions.hint: An exchange programme = a programme where students go to study at a university in another country.
